scope: All 63 character learning tables and acquisition highlights, no subset focus. Four source sites reviewed: GameWith global skill/art/magic tables; Hyperwiki character pages; Gamecap per-character ranks; Game8 per-character acquired skills.
policy: Prefer exact rank agreement in two source sites, or an explicit rank plus independent Game8 character membership/effect. Additional literal Hyperwiki character-table records are included when there is no conflicting rank and the complete named effect is explicit; these are tagged explicit-character-table and are not claimed to have two rank confirmations. New rank conflicts and OCR-damaged effects are held. No extrapolation of learning from other characters. Data omissions are not evidence of non-learnability.
